policy.selection: fixed before evaluation; no threshold comparison or optimization

provenance.verification: Frozen checkpoint/metadata/contract and all compressed NPZ hashes; exact actual train/validation memberships and per-match sample counts; existing development_splits and ShardSplit loader; no full replay audit

limitations: This validation fold was already used for checkpoint/model selection; it is not a new independent blind test.
Target inclusion measures observed discard agreement, not optimal play or win probability.
Rates are weighted by decisions; known-player and repeated-state dependence remains.
Test and historical_test rows were excluded from inference; no training, calibration, downloads, threshold search, or artifact/database writes were performed.
